title: Assessment AI advisory narrative
description: Structured advisory narrative over already-extracted facts. The model may only restate the evidence it was given; it never decides. Validated by services.llm_providers.validate_json_schema before anything is persisted.

summary_text.description: Concise professional summary of the provided facts only.

evidence_index.description: Index into the evidence array the point is drawn from.

review_flags.description: Anything a human must look at before any decision (gaps, contradictions, low-confidence evidence).

needs_review.description: Always true: the narrative is advisory and never a decision.
